findings.text: the plan's focused-set clause requires the same failure ids at the base and the head, but only the head arm (job 1339236) has a log; base equality rests on benchmarks/outboard_census_exact_total.py being unchanged rather than on a base-arm run.

the absence check and the module-import sweep exist only in the run directory, so nothing committed fails if a later change imports one of the 24 deleted modules; the record names the debt and its discharge shape but leaves it unbuilt.

imports_of and imports_of_walk own AST import resolution, and the run's scan.py re-derives it rather than extending the owner; the owner cannot parse at either revision because of the Python-2 except at line 417, and that repair belongs to a benchmarks/ node.
